source: List prices in USD per million tokens (standard tier), from the vendors' pricing pages, checked on 2026-10-10: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (Anthropic) and https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (OpenAI). claude-haiku-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol carry their short-prompt prices (Haiku 5.5: a prompt of up to 100,000 tokens; gpt-6.1-sol: up to 272K input tokens); a longer request costs more, which this file does not model. Check them against the current price list before you rely on a figure. local is the model of each call of the opencode adapter (a local model behind an OpenAI-compatible API on the owner's own host): it costs $0 for each token.
